result_text:
The region overview now lists open support tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. The change is one query in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, around line 10023: `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` now uses the same `ORDER BY CASE t.priority ...` clause as the sales-rep list, and its Javadoc says so. The region overview is the only caller, so nothing else changes.

`RegionManagerTest`, `RegionReportTest` and `DashboardTest` pass with `mvn -q -o test`. I didn't add a test for the new order, and I didn't run your example data through it, so that ordering is untested. Nothing is committed.
